{{rt|214|Sinnoh}} }} '''Cleaning Up Grimer''' (Japanese: '''VS ベトベター''' ''VS Grimer''), titled '''VS Grimer''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 403rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 66th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Pearl and the New Team''' (Japanese: '''パールと新チーム''' ''Pearl and the New Team'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Pearl and the New Team''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} After revealing to {{adv|Pearl}} that {{adv|Diamond}} is inside of a [[Team Galactic]] airship, [[Johanna]] recounts his story of how he got there. She explains that Diamond attempted to free {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit}} by jumping onto the net that was trapping it, as well as using [[Tru]] and [[Kit]] to open it. Despite their efforts, both Pokémon fell into [[Lake Verity]], and Diamond was pulled inside the aircraft with the net. Diamond eventually realized that [[Mars]] was not on board with him, and that she likely believed Diamond had fallen into the lake with Tru. {{adv|Sebastian}} reveals that it was [[Fantina's Drifblim]] that had rescued Diamond's Pokémon. When Pearl is confused about how Sebastian knows Diamond, he introduces himself as the butler for the [[House of Berlitz|Berlitz family]]. Glad that Diamond is well, Pearl takes Tru and Kit in order to return them. Before he leaves for [[Veilstone City]], [[Rad Rickshaw]] gives him a new bicycle. When Pearl sets off, [[Crasher Wake]] reassures Johanna that he believes in him. She recalls the conversation she had with Diamond over the phone when he told her his plans to take on Team Galactic. When Johanna tried to dissuade Diamond from putting himself in danger, he reminded her of [[Proteam Omega]], his favorite show. Diamond explained that while he initially believed villains only existed on television, his experiences with Team Galactic proved him wrong. Diamond vowed to Johanna that he would stop Team Galactic from harming others. As Pearl makes his way to Veilstone City, he finds several {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s blocking the path ahead. He sends out {{p|Buizel|Zeller}}, but it only attacks him. When the grunts' Pokémon charge for Zeller, it creates a harsh wind by rapidly spinning its tail, causing the grunts to shield their eyes. They don't notice as something burrows its way through the ground toward their Pokémon. A {{p|Diglett}} bursts through the earth, and the Pokémon try futilely to catch it. While they are distracted, a {{p|Tauros}} barrels into them, defeating them. Pearl praises Diglett and Tauros, revealing that the two Pokémon are the new additions to his team. A {{p|Grimer}} approaches Pearl from behind and attempts to attack him, but his new Pokémon make short work of it. Standing proudly with his full team, Pearl prepares to head for the [[Team Galactic HQ]]. ==Major events== * {{adv|Pearl}} reveals his full team, which includes a new {{p|Tauros}} and {{p|Diglett}}. * Pearl heads towards [[Veilstone City]] to return [[Tru]] and [[Kit]] to {{adv|Diamond}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} (flashback) * {{adv|Pearl}} * [[Crasher Wake]] * [[Mars]] (flashback) * [[Cyrus]] (flashback) * [[Johanna]] * [[Rad Rickshaw]] * {{adv|Sebastian}} * [[Roseanne]] * {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s * [[Valley Windworks]] manager (flashback) * {{tc|Roughneck}}s (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}};
